material_definitions: The study investigated the substitution of P5+ with Si4+ in the solid solutions Li(6+x)P(1-x)Si(x)S5X to understand the effect of aliovalent doping in Li+ conducting argyrodites.
Increasing the Si4+ content increases the Li+ concentration and leads to a rising occupancy of Li+ on the transition state for hopping.
warnings: The conductivity value is reported as 'greater than 2 mS cm-1'.
Temperature (25 C) is inferred as room temperature since no specific measurement temperature was provided.
The specific composition (x and X) resulting in this conductivity is not precisely defined.

material_definitions: The investigated materials are solid solutions of $\mathrm{Li}_{6+x}\mathrm{P}_{1-x}\mathrm{Si}_x\mathrm{S}_5\mathrm{Br}$, identified as argyrodite superionic conductors.
Ionic transport was assessed using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy.
The substitution of $\mathrm{P}^{5+}$ with $\mathrm{Si}^{4+}$ increases the $\mathrm{Li}^{+}$ content, leading to enhanced conductivity.
